direction: Original adult characters redesigned using the two user-supplied cel-painted full-body reference illustrations

entries.prompt:
Create a finished original adult character illustration for a Japanese 2D fantasy tactical RPG, closely matching the drawing style and overall clothing coverage of the two PROVIDED CUTOUT GAME ILLUSTRATIONS. Use these two provided images as the primary art direction, ignoring all earlier artwork. The design must look like a polished hand-inked game character cutout, not a realistic painting: crisp varied dark-colored contour lines; deliberately designed angular shapes in hair, cloth and feathers; clean restrained two- or three-tone cel coloring; expressive stylized adult face; attractive natural mature adult proportions about 7.5 heads tall; carefully separated areas of flat color. Small, specific graphic highlight marks. Real studio drawing with confidently designed negative space. Preserve the lively floating character-composition format of the references. Absolutely NO misty scenic background, painterly skin, metallic micro-ornament, noisy filigree, realistic reflections, 3D-render finish, text or logo.
The entire character is an unequivocally grown WOMAN AGE 30, with a mature adult face and tall graceful body. Make her confident and alluring in a fantastical revealing outfit: deep but opaque neckline, bare shoulders, visible waist, upper thighs exposed, opaque high-cut hip coverage, slender ribbons and small jewelry. The clothing coverage should be comparable to the supplied game illustrations. No nudity. This is a complete costume design with strong readability at 200 px.
COMPOSITION: one complete full-body character on a true transparent alpha background, including all cloth, ribbons, weapons, accessories and both feet, surrounded by generous empty margin. No frame or card UI. Her pose should be asymmetrical, relaxed and magically suspended, one knee drawn up slightly, the other leg reaching down, with sweeping cloth and prop silhouettes surrounding her into an expressive S-curve. Contour edges are clean and intentional, and all hands and feet are well drawn. Avoid copying the reference character's exact face or emblem; invent the following new original design.
DESIGN A: an ivory-feather tide oracle. Long PALE AQUA hair in a loose side braid which releases into curling ends, golden-green eyes, small silver feather-and-droplet hair clasp. Pearl WHITE and very pale lavender opaque petal-shaped swimsuit-like costume with narrow gold ties, an exposed midriff, detached flowing sleeves, a small asymmetric waist drape, bare legs and delicate ribbon sandals. One shoulder bears a layered fan of white feathers. Several large stylized white-and-blue swallows are drawn around her in a graceful open crescent, their flight feathers and elongated tails forming an elegant silhouette connected to her sleeves. She holds a small moon-shaped water talisman above her extended hand and draws her other hand toward her collar. Give her a calm self-assured adult expression. Poses and feather movement should have the light airy elegance of reference image 1. White is the dominant color, lavender in the shadow shapes, accents of ice blue and small pale gold. Each cloth fold and each feather is simplified into a few clear painted shapes. A floating, sensual high-fantasy collector-card illustration, vivid 2D cel drawing.
entries.cleanup_prompt: Technical cleanup of this approved full-body fantasy RPG cutout. Preserve the exact adult character design, face, anatomy, costume, revealing coverage, pose, ink outlines and clean cel-painted colors. Reframe the composition at 82 percent of the canvas so there is a real transparent margin of at least 8 percent on ALL FOUR edges. Restore any tiny tips cut by the current canvas edge. All feathers, ribbons, cloth, hair, shoes and props fit completely within the image. Remove colored fringe artifacts and isolated colored background speckles; keep clean anti-aliased contours and intended translucent effects. Empty space is truly transparent alpha, including interior spaces between ribbons and body. Do not add any new motif or backdrop, do not repaint the illustration in another style. One complete illustration, no text, no frame.
